answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using ambient entropy attestation. Nodes register by publishing proofs of local physical dynamics, such as wave surge at a wharf, water turbulence in a river, or sap flow along a vine. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying dedicated physical sensors across separate sites per identity. However, adversaries can relay one sensor feed over fast networks to authenticate multiple co-located clones.
